title: xantolis burmanica
intro: Xantolis burmanica, commonly known as the Burmese yellow-berried xanthosis, is a plant species belonging to the family Sapotaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting anti-inflammatory properties. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Xantolis burmanica as a medicinal plant, but its bioactive constituents have shown promise in various studies.
